settings.description: Answers about our formulas, your routine, orders and returns.

settings.question: Are your products suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. Every formula is fragrance-free or scented only by its herbs, and we patch-test each batch. If you react to a product, we refund it within 30 days.

settings.question: Are your products vegan?
settings.answer: All of our formulas are vegan except where a product page says otherwise. None are tested on animals.

settings.question: How long does a bottle last once opened?
settings.answer: Use within 12 months of opening. The open-jar symbol on each label shows the period in months.

settings.question: How does Subscribe & save work?
settings.answer: Choose a delivery every 30 or 60 days on the product page and save 10% on every order. You can skip or cancel from your account at any time.

settings.question: When will my order ship?
settings.answer: Orders placed before 1 pm ship the same working day. Delivery options and estimates are shown at checkout.

settings.question: Can I return an opened product?
settings.answer: Yes. If a product does not suit your skin, contact us within 30 days of delivery and we will refund it.

settings.heading: Write to the studio
settings.text: Tell us your skin type and what you are using now, and we will suggest a routine. We reply within one working day.
